note: The glazed blue door on the left wall is the way out to the square (hierarchy Back, no second painted control).

items.label: la poste
items.scene: A pigeon in a little cap pushes a letter into the big brass slot of the POST ("POST") OFFICE wall.

items.label: l'adresse
items.scene: A postwoman reads the ADDRESS label pinned to A DRESS ("ah-DREHS") on the coat stand.

items.label: l'enveloppe
items.scene: A LOP-eared rabbit ("ahn-vuh-LOP") sits hugging a giant ENVELOPE that leans against its paws.

items.label: l'expédition
items.scene: Three penguins in woolly hats set off on an EXPEDITION ("ehk-spay-dee-SYOHN"), pulling a sledge of parcels toward the South Pole.

items.label: le paquet
items.scene: A boy in a green coat staggers under a PARCEL wrapped like a giant PACKET ("pah-KEH") of crisps.

items.label: le choc
items.scene: A boy in a red coat jumps back in SHOCK ("SHOK") as a jack-in-the-box springs out of a parcel.

items.label: le courrier
items.scene: A girl COURIER ("koo-RYAY") zooms in on roller skates with a satchel full of MAIL.

items.label: le télégramme
items.scene: A messenger boy hands a TELEGRAM to his GRAN ("tay-lay-GRAHM"), who smiles as she reads it.

items.label: le timbre
items.scene: A monkey shakes a TAMBOURINE ("TANBR") beside a giant postage STAMP on an easel that shows the very same tambourine.

items.label: le drapeau
items.scene: A big blue-white-red FLAG DRAPES ("drah-POH") over the balcony rail above the counter.

zoom_from.painted_as: the three brass-framed counter windows with the clerk, RIGHT wall
the tall oak sorting cabinet of pigeonholes, BACK CENTRE
